title: Water Restored — Community — May 29
_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. The potable water shutoff is still ongoing. Is was caused by Duke Energy's subcontractor. We currently anticipate another hour. We will notify you as soon as it is restored. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
